name: python-lsm-tree
title: Tiered Keys
blurb: A log-structured merge table of integer keys and string values: a sorted memtable flushes to numbered on-disk level tables, reads fall through newest level first, and compaction merges sorted tables while dropping tombstones.
default_description: An LSM table whose memtable flushes to numbered level tables, answers newest-level-first, and proves every answer equals the dict answer over seeded workloads.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a tombstone outranks the value it buries
